title: Add audio range debug visualization for AudioStreamPlayer2D V1

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
# What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Currently, there is no way to visualize the audible range of an `AudioStreamPlayer2D` in either the editor or while the game is running. The node provides configuration properties such as `max_distance` and `attenuation`, but these properties are only represented as numeric values, and there is no easy way to visualize what they actually represent in the game.

---

# Solution

This PR adds support for visualizing the audible range of every `AudioStreamPlayer2D` in the editor by introducing new settings under **Project Settings > Debug > Shapes**. These settings allow users to enable or disable the visualization and configure how it is rendered, it also adds a new **Debug > Visible Audio Range** option, allowing the same visualization to be displayed while the game is running, making it easier to debug positional audio.

Additionally, this PR includes an editor plugin for `AudioStreamPlayer2D` that provides an interactive handle for editing the `max_distance` property directly in the 2D editor, similar to how the radius of a `CircleShape2D` can be adjusted through a `CollisionShape2D`.

### Important

This implementation displays the audible range for every `AudioStreamPlayer2D` in the scene simultaneously. During the proposal discussion, some concerns were raised that this could introduce visual clutter in scenes containing many audio nodes, especially when several overlap, because of that feedback, I created an alternative implementation where the visualization is integrated into the editor gizmo and is only shown for the currently selected node. That version does not include in-game debug visualization, the alternative implementation can be found [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121984).

---
